question: Does limited ground-truth correction change transfer of policies trained under frozen low-energy world models?
experiment_type: Simulation-only generative-oracle intervention: replace selected model transitions with true transitions at the same queried state/action. Not a deployable robot data-collection protocol.
true_transition_selection: Exact budget, uniformly sampled collection indices without replacement; paired selection across model families and model seeds for each policy seed
replay: Single pool of model/oracle transitions; batch 256; no additional Dyna rollout data
reference_reuse: At budget 16000 the world model is never queried; train one true-only reference per policy seed and explicitly reuse it across world-model cases. Do not count aliases as independent runs.
task_and_hyperparameters: Same SAC, reward, action bound, integration, duration and strict success criterion as calibrated Phase 3
checkpoint_selection: Final fixed budget; no held-out selection
domain_guard: Reset a lane at nonfinite state or |p|>10; discard only nonfinite transitions; report all exits; do not clip momentum
evaluation: Same paired 32 states in each of five energy bands, actual true dynamics, deterministic actor; evaluation oracle calls excluded from training budget and never used for updates
intervention_simulations: Coupled conservative pendulums on T^2; matched uniform-torus RMS force perturbations separating conservative error, zero-curl nonzero-cycle error and nonzero-curl error. Analytic interventions, not learned 2D models.
candidate_novelty: Mechanism and control relevance of global work-loop consistency; requires further primary-literature review and learned multi-dimensional experiments
